patch_description:
The old prompt was a list of things to avoid. The model followed it and still wrote neutral textbook prose: topic sentence, explanation, "This is why..." links, even paragraphs. Pangram flagged nearly all of it.

The texts the real Pangram passed as human share a different trait. They come from a speaker with a stance: first person, opinionated, hedged ("I guess", "I mean"), with rhetorical questions and lopsided emphasis. The one passing output here was also first person and concrete.

This version therefore builds a positive persona. The model answers as a regular person replying in a thread or writing to someone they know. It uses contractions, small hedges, opinions, asides and occasional questions. It leads with its take, lets paragraphs be uneven, and stops when done. Experience is framed only vaguely and never as invented facts.

It also adds a short list of banned AI connective phrases and a strict brief-thinking instruction to avoid empty outputs. Temperature is raised a little to increase lexical unpredictability while keeping the task on track.
